meta.sql: CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

roles.sql:
CREATE TABLE roles(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('admin','manager','staff')),
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  is_system INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

role_permissions.sql:
CREATE TABLE role_permissions(
  role_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(id),
  perm_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(role_id, perm_key)
)

users.sql:
CREATE TABLE users(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(id),
  login_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (login_type IN ('password','pin')),
  secret_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_owner INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  failed_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  locked_until TEXT,
  must_change_secret INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_by INTEGER,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, reports_to INTEGER)

user_grants.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_grants(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  perm_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (effect IN ('allow','deny')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT,
  granted_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  revoked_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)
)

sessions.sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions(
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  device_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (device_mode IN ('shared','personal')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
, insights_until TEXT, user_agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

settings.sql: CREATE TABLE settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, changed_by INTEGER, changed_at TEXT)

i18n_overrides.sql:

, sizes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', voice_rate REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.95)
